main_body: A small wooden chair seen from the front: a tall backrest with two horizontal slats between side posts, and a seat plank near the bottom with two legs below. The seat reads as a thin front band, not a surface seen from above.
top_band: No real top band. Rows 2-3 (light orange #d59147) are the top rail of the backrest, a vertical face. The seat at rows 10-12 is a 2-3 row band with no distinct top surface.
evidence: The column at x=10 runs: 1 dark outline, 2-3 light rail, 4 mid, 5 dark, 6-7 mid, 8 dark, 9-11 mid, 12 light, 13 dark, 14 black. The light rows at 2-3 belong to the backrest top rail, which is a vertical face, and the seat at rows 9-12 is a thin band of the same tone family as the front. No horizontal seat surface is visible from above. This matches the red 'thin seat' and front elevation cases in the guide.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 8 distinct colours and a median of 8 colours per tile, against 38-40 distinct colours and 17-20 per tile in the references. It has about 4 lightness steps in orange and brown, with no grain or texture dots. Its dark edges are 58% neutral, so the outline is partly near-black and partly brown. It is small and simple but clearly thinner than the Beodeul references.
